content: Hessa gishshas Abraamey ba machcheyranne baas dizaaz ubbaara Gibxeppe Negebe bazzo bides; Looxeykka izara bides.
Abraamey he wode mehen, biraninne worqqan daro duretides.
Izi Negebeppe dendidi Beetele gakkanaas bides; Beeteleppenne Ayeppe giddon diza dere bides; hesoykka izi koyro ba dunkaane tolidi,
yarsho shiishshanaas keexxidaso; heenkka Abraamey GODAA sunth xeygides.
Abraamera yuuyiza Looxeska daro miizi, dorsi, deyshinne dunkaaney dees.
Gido attiin isttas daro mehey diza gishshassinne istti issife daanaas isttas biittay xuummida gishshas issife daanaas dandaybeettenna.
Hessa geedon Abraame wude heemmizayta giddoninne Looxe wude heemmizayta giddon ooshshi medhettides; he wode Kanaanetinne Paarizeti he biittan deettes.
Histtiin Abraamey Looxes, «Nuni ishantta gidida gishshas, nu giddon, ta mehe heemmizayta giddoninne ne mehe heemmizayta giddon oosh medhdhofa.
Biittay wuri ne sinththan deennee? Ane nuni shaakettoos; neni hadirsa bagga biikko, tani ushachcha bagga baana; neni ushachcha bagga biikko tani hadirsa bagga baana» gides.

Looxey yuuyi aadhdhi xeellidi Yordaanoose shoobbay biidi Zo7aare gakkanaas GODAA gannate woykko Gibxe biitta mala daro haaththi dizayssa be7ides. (Hessika GODAY Sodoomenne Gamoora geetettiza katamata dhayssanaappe kase.)
Hessa gishshas Looxey baas Yordaanoose shoobba ubbaa dooridi arshey mokkiza baggara bida gishshas istti ba garsan shaakettida.
Abraamey Kanaane biittan de7ides; Looxey gidikko shoobban diza gita katamata giddon uttidi Sodoome katama matan ba Dunkaaneza tolides.
He wode Sodoome asay iitanne GODAA sinththan pala nagara ooththizayta.
Looxey Abraameppe shaakettidaappe guye GODAY Abraame, «Dhoqqu gaada neni dizasoppe arshey mokkiza bagganne geliza bagga qasse dugeha bagganne pudeha bagga xeella.
Hayssa neni xeelliza biitta ubbaa ta neessinne ne zereththas mernaas immana.
Tani ne zereth biitta ace mala darsana; oonikka biitta ace taybana dandaykko ne zereththika taybettana.
Dendada biitta bolla pudenne duge, yaanne ha yuuya xeella; gaasoykka tani hayssa biittaa nees immana» gides.
Histtiin Abraamey ba Dunkaaneza shoddidi, Kebroonen Mamire geetettizason diza gita miththaa achchan de7anaas bides. Heenkka GODAAS yarsho yarshizaso keexxides.
